label: SDXL / Pony / Illustrious — Tags

must: Comma-separated Danbooru-style tags in lowercase, no sentences.
Order: subject count and type, body and hair, expression, wardrobe, pose and action, explicit tags, setting, lighting, composition, style.
Use established booru tag spellings (1girl, solo, looking at viewer, from below, cowboy shot).
Weight at most three tags with (tag:1.1) to (tag:1.4).
avoid: Invented tags that no booru tagger uses.

notes_for_model: Pony and Illustrious checkpoints respond to score tags, but this profile leaves them out on purpose — the user adds the checkpoint-specific prefix. Deliver only content tags.
